description: Local fixtures for nexitally-node-parser.js. Hosts, passwords, and tags are fictional. Do not replace these with a real subscription.

cases.name: typical-full-config
cases.notes: A Nexitally-style full Quantumult X download: info lines, AnyTLS nodes, a [Premium] placeholder, and later policy/filter sections that must not leak into the server resource.

cases.name: mixed-protocols
cases.notes: Every protocol the parser accepts, plus an unsupported line that must be dropped.

cases.name: duplicates-and-placeholders
cases.notes: Exact-line de-duplication and exclusion of traffic, expiry, remaining-quota, and [Premium] rows.

cases.name: comments-whitespace-and-crlf
cases.notes: BOM, Windows newlines, padded section headers, and comment prefixes ; # //.

cases.name: section-case-and-trailing-content
cases.notes: Case-insensitive [SERVER_LOCAL] and a file that ends inside that section.

cases.name: missing-server-local
cases.error: Nexitally parser: [server_local] section was not found.
cases.notes: A full profile that only has [server_remote] must fail clearly.

cases.name: empty-server-local
cases.error: Nexitally parser: no usable server entries were found.
cases.notes: The section exists but contains only comments.

cases.name: traffic-only
cases.error: Nexitally parser: no usable server entries were found.
cases.notes: Info rows that look like servers still match the exclusion list.
